name: @umbeli-com/e2e
description: Shared Playwright E2E harness for Umbeli SaaS apps — network mocks (Supabase/Stripe), config preset, acceptance-checklist gate.

scripts.typecheck: node -e "Promise.all(['index','mocks','config','acceptance','net','crawl','asserts'].map(m=>import('./src/'+m+'.js'))).then(()=>console.log('e2e: 7 modules OK'),e=>{if(e.code==='ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND'&&/playwright/.test(e.message)){console.log('e2e: OK (@playwright/test absent, peer)');return}throw e})"
